title: How should we communicate election polls?
authors: Elias Koch, Linus Hagemann, Simon Munzert, Hannah Rajski, Thomas Gschwend, Cornelius Erfort, and Lukas F. Stoetzer.
abstract: Visual conjoint at the 2025 German federal election (N = 23,695): 160 randomised presentations of the same poll to voters, journalists, and candidates. Charts (bars, dots, lines) beat plain text on attractiveness and trust; technical details have mixed effects. Implications for evidence-based poll reporting.
